===Specifications=== *CPU: [[Rockchip]] RK3588 @2.4GHz Quad-core ARM (Cortex-A76) :+ @1.8GHz Quad-Core ARM (Cortex-A55) *GPU: ''Mali-G610'' MP4 (OpenGL ES3.2, OpenCL 2.2); NPU Support 6T, :VPU (with 8K@60fps VP9 and 8K@30fps H265/H264 decoding) *Storage: 32MB (SPI) Flash, 32GB, 64GB, or 256GB eMMC, :TF card (max.128GB)/MMC card, NVMe SSD (M.2) slot *Memory: 4GB, 8GB, or 16GB (LPDDR4X) SDRAM @2133MHz *USB: 1x USB 3.1 (Type-C) DP1.4/OT port, :1x USB 3.0 (USB 3.1 Gen 1), 2x USB 2.0 ports, :2x USB 2.0 headers *PCIe: 1x M.2 (M key) socket, 1x M.2 (E key) socket *Network: 2x 2.5Gb Ethernet ports *GPIO: 1x 40-pin headers *Power Source: 12V/2A via DC jack or 2-pin connector
